channel.title: Pier & Point · Chase Center Parking Garage (150 Warriors Way)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Chase Center Parking Garage (150 Warriors Way) (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Chase Center Parking Garage (150 Warriors Way): The 2007 building permit proposed a…
item.description: The 2007 building permit proposed a garage "with 7 stories"; Assessor records give 9 stories. The permit was completed on 2009-10-23 (a permit sign-off, not an opening date). The 469,726 figure is the Assessor's "property_area" ("Square footage of property"), not a measured building area. Source: https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=200705090778; https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8721030.

item.title: Correction · Chase Center Parking Garage (150 Warriors Way): The Chase Center garage page no…
item.description: The Chase Center garage page no longer says it has nine stories: the Assessor lists nine and the 2007 building permit says seven, so both are shown. Source: DataSF Assessor Secured Roll wv5m-vpq2, parcel 8721030; DataSF Building Permits i98e-djp9, permit 200705090778.

item.title: Correction · Chase Center Parking Garage (150 Warriors Way): The record's summary said the garage…
item.description: The record's summary said the garage serves Chase Center and was built about a decade before it opened; the cited Assessor roll says neither, so both were removed and the map notes now call it an inference. The permit cost entry no longer credits the permit with the 469,726 sq ft floor area, which is the Assessor's figure, and the unsourced name 'Uber Mission Bay 2' was replaced with the 1515 3rd St address. The NAIP photo credit now names the Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, and the Commons photo no longer says it was taken from a departing flight. Source: DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, parcel 8721030 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8721030); DataSF Building Permits, permit #200705090778 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=200705090778); USDA NAIP imagery catalog record (https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/national-agriculture-imagery-program-naip-imagery); Wikimedia Commons, aerial photo file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg).
